data.about: Six non-concurrent forces are reduced to a single resultant with the funicular polygon. The force polygon gives R's magnitude and direction; choosing a pole decomposes every force into two components, and the strings drawn across the lines of action make the opposite components neutralize each other — only the first and last survive, so extending those two strings locates R's line of action.
